title: Quick Shulker
description: A Shulker Box mod that lets you quickly move items in and out without placing it down!
body: QuickShulker brings bundle-like interactions to Shulker Boxes. Move items in and out directly from your inventory without placing the Shulker Box down. Inspired by Minecraft's Bundle mechanics, this lightweight quality-of-life mod makes inventory management faster, smoother, and more convenient while remaining faithful to the vanilla experience.
